title: Persist session-scoped context read attestations
summary: Avoid repeated context reads while invalidating sessions after real entity changes.
description: Implement durable session-scoped context-read attestations without changing semantic entity timestamps. Current read tracking in packages/plan-core/src/read-tracking.ts is process-global despite per-session comments, while task/phase/feature/requirement documents already expose updatedAt fields used for lifecycle context. Add a bounded sessionInfo record to the relevant persisted entities or equivalent schema-owned metadata, preserving updatedAt when bookkeeping is written. The lifecycle gate in packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts and packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts must accept a current session only when its sessionInfo entry exists and the entity updatedAt has not advanced beyond the read timestamp; otherwise it must require the exact full context sequence and explicit linked-requirement read. Preserve public API compatibility, composite IDs, atomic PlanStore writes, WebSocket semantics, and task lifecycle behavior. Cover same-session reuse, real entity-change invalidation, session isolation, metadata-write timestamp preservation, stale-entry pruning, Pi/MCP parity, and no repeated parent reads after valid cached context.

tasks.title: Define persisted sessionInfo and timestamp-preserving writes
tasks.description:
Update packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts and packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts to define the persisted sessionInfo shape for task, phase, feature, and linked requirement context reads. Store opaque sessionId plus createdAt/read timestamp, deduplicate entries, bound or prune stale entries, and ensure metadata-only writes preserve each entity's semantic updatedAt and descriptionUpdatedAt. Add an atomic PlanStore API that records a completed context-read attestation without changing lifecycle status, generated content, or unrelated fields. Preserve schema compatibility for existing plans and verify rollback/atomicity under concurrent metadata updates.

---
**Completion summary:**
Added backward-compatible sessionInfo arrays to task, phase, feature, and requirement schemas and introduced PlanStore.recordContextRead. The API atomically records one completed context-read attestation across the target entities, deduplicates per session, caps history at 16 entries, validates referenced requirements, preserves updatedAt/descriptionUpdatedAt, and rolls back completed writes on failure. Added core tests for persistence, deduplication, bounded pruning, timestamp preservation, and missing-requirement non-mutation. Verification: pnpm check, core build, focused session-info tests 2/2, and git diff --check passed. Remaining: adapter/session-aware eligibility wiring is covered by T334-T335.

tasks.title: Make context-read eligibility session-aware
tasks.description:
Refactor packages/plan-core/src/read-tracking.ts and its callers so context readiness is scoped by an explicit agent session ID rather than one process-global singleton. Preserve the required initial task_get(full=true) → phase_get(full=true) → feature_get(full=true) ordering and separate requirement-list gate, then persist an attestation after the complete tree is read. On task_start, task resume, or task switch, reuse the phase/task/feature/requirement context only when the current sessionInfo entries exist and no entity updatedAt has advanced since the attestation; otherwise return the existing typed prerequisite denial. Keep session reset, pause/switch invalidation, orphan phases, and public compatibility behavior explicit and tested.

---
**Completion summary:**
Refactored plan-core read tracking into explicit per-session state with compatibility wrappers. Added session-aware full-context and linked-requirement eligibility that can reuse persisted sessionInfo only while every current entity updatedAt remains at or before the attestation timestamp; changed entities fall back to the exact ordered read denial. Added explicit session initialization, per-session invalidation, session-isolation tests, persisted-attestation invalidation tests, and retained legacy APIs. Verification: pnpm check, core build, read-tracking/session-info focused tests 10/10, and git diff --check passed. Remaining: Pi/MCP session propagation and adapter read wiring are covered by T335.

tasks.title: Wire Pi and MCP session context reuse
tasks.description:
Update packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts and packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts to create and propagate stable session IDs for the lifetime of each harness session. Read handlers must complete and attest the task/phase/feature/requirement tree once; later task_start, resume, and switch calls must consult the session-aware core gate instead of instructing agents to reread unchanged parents. When an entity updatedAt changes, return the precise typed read-required failure and exact retry sequence. Update tool descriptions, injected planner rules, recap guidance, and lifecycle diagnostics to say reads are reused until session or entity invalidation, without weakening the hard gate.

---
**Completion summary:**
Wired stable per-harness session IDs through Pi session_start and the MCP server, converted full feature/phase/task/requirement reads to session-scoped tracking, and updated task_start, task_switch, resume paths to validate persisted sessionInfo against current updatedAt values. Valid context is reused without repeating parent reads; stale context returns typed retry guidance; fresh reads replace stale attestations. Updated lifecycle descriptions and injected Pi rules to say reads are reused until session or entity invalidation. Verification: pnpm check, production build, focused Pi lifecycle/switch tests 2/2, focused MCP lifecycle/switch tests 2/2, read-tracking/session-info tests 10/10, and git diff --check passed. Remaining: broader cross-harness invalidation and no-token-burn regression coverage is T336.

tasks.title: Fix cross-harness session identity and granular context-read reuse
tasks.description:
Correct the session-scoped context attestation contract introduced in `packages/plan-core/src/read-tracking.ts`, `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts`, `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`, and `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`. Current behavior regenerates Pi's planner session identifier with `randomUUID()` on every `session_start`, including reloads of the same logical Pi session, while Pi exposes the stable `ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId()`. The shared eligibility check is also all-or-nothing: a stale task attestation forces unchanged phase, feature, and linked requirements to be read again, and the static extension rule still instructs agents to perform the complete read sequence before every start/resume/switch. Implement a harness-agnostic core contract using an opaque session identifier and per-entity freshness, use Pi's stable logical session UUID, define explicit safe MCP semantics for Claude Code, Codex, and future clients without coupling plan-core to any harness, and preserve isolation when no stable MCP client session ID is available. Update start/switch diagnostics and agent-only rules so callers invoke the lifecycle operation first and then read only the missing or stale entities in the required order. Preserve public TypeScript exports, persisted schema compatibility, timestamp-preserving metadata writes, requirement-read enforcement, atomic PlanStore writes, and strict isolation between distinct sessions. Add regressions for Pi reload/resume/fork behavior, MCP process/session boundaries, sibling-task parent reuse, task-only invalidation after waiting/pause changes, individual parent/requirement invalidation, and rule/tool guidance that must not trigger unconditional duplicate reads.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented and verified cross-harness session identity plus granular context-read reuse. Plan-core now composes fresh in-memory reads with valid persisted per-entity attestations, reports precise missing/stale/out-of-order reads, reuses unchanged phase/feature descriptions across sibling tasks and task lifecycle churn, and keeps linked requirements independently fresh. Pi now keys attestations with the stable `ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId()` logical-session UUID and scopes invalidation to that session; MCP uses the transport `RequestHandlerExtra.sessionId` when available and an isolated per-process fallback for stdio clients such as Claude Code/Codex. Task start/switch, recap guidance, generated Claude setup instructions, shared plugin skill, and canonical extension rules now use a lifecycle-first protocol and follow only returned `nextActions`; exact legacy canonical rules are upgraded in memory without mutating static project overrides. Preserved existing public TypeScript exports, schema compatibility, timestamp-preserving PlanStore writes, atomic persistence, and requirement enforcement. Verification: `pnpm check` passed; plan-core full suite 238/238; Pi adapter 60/60; MCP 52/52; agent-plan CLI 6/6; plugin derivation check passed; final `pnpm test:coverage` passed 464/464 Node tests plus 44/44 Web UI tests at 85.66% lines, 73.64% branches, and 80.42% functions. Package-only Pi/MCP runners still report their known isolated baseline-threshold exits despite zero test failures. Files changed: packages/plan-core/src/{read-tracking.ts,planner-rules.ts,recap.ts}, corresponding core tests, packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts and Pi host/mutation tests, packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts and MCP CRUD tests, packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts and CLI setup test, plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in, and generated plugins/claude-code/skills/planner/SKILL.md. No remaining implementation work is known; no commit or push was performed.

tasks.title: Run cross-harness session-read integration and Playwright verification
tasks.description:
Verification-only follow-up for the T337 implementation in `packages/plan-core/src/read-tracking.ts`, `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`, and `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`. Run focused Node integration tests against isolated temporary planner roots to verify granular missing/stale diagnostics, sibling-task parent and requirement reuse, stable Pi SessionManager identity across reloads, and MCP process/session isolation. Then run the real-server Playwright suite from `e2e/` as a Web UI regression smoke test, explicitly documenting that browser tests do not directly exercise agent-session attestations. Do not change production behavior, coverage thresholds, package versions, branches, or git history. If a failure exposes a real defect, stop and report it before implementing any correction.

---
**Completion summary:**
Completed an independent verification pass for T337 without changing production code, tests, thresholds, versions, branches, or git history. Focused plan-core verification built @agent-plan/core and passed 19/19 read-tracking plus session-info tests, covering granular missing/stale reads, task-only rereads combined with persisted parent attestations, sibling-task parent reuse, description-specific parent invalidation, requirement freshness, explicit session isolation, and legacy-rule in-memory upgrade. Pi integration built @agent-plan/pi-adapter and passed 13/13 mutation/lifecycle tests against isolated temporary planner roots, including same-logical-session reload continuity, task-only resume reread, sibling parent/requirement reuse, and denial for a distinct SessionManager UUID. MCP integration built @agent-plan/mcp and passed 8/8 real stdio client/server tests, including task-only resume reread, sibling reuse, and isolation between distinct server processes sharing one temporary planner root. The complete real-server Playwright suite passed 22/22 across Chromium desktop and 390px touch/mobile projects after a full production build. Playwright confirms no Web UI/server regression but does not directly exercise Pi/MCP agent-session attestations; those are validated by the focused integration suites. `git diff --check` passed, and verification introduced no additional tracked source changes. No commit or push was performed.
